Cold Damage is one of the Damage Types, it is mitigated by Cold Protection, Elemental Protection, and Block Protection.

## Contents

- 1 Known Modifiers

- 1.1 Character Stats

- 1.2 Affixes

- 1.3 Equipment Implicits

- 2 List of Cold Damage Skills

- 2.1 NPC

## Known Modifiers[]

### Character Stats[]

- Increased Cold Damage

- Increased Elemental Damage

- Attunement (as a result of increasing elemental damage)

### Affixes[]

- Added Melee Cold Damage (only effects Melee Attack Skills)

- Increased Cold Damage

### Equipment Implicits[]

- Coldstone Wand provides added cold damage to spells.

- Northern Axe, Mountain Axe and Tundra Axe and its variants provide added melee cold damage

- Sapphire Ring provides increased cold damge

### NPC[]

There are currently no known cold damage skills for NPCs.
